examined_and_rejected.title: G. Smith, The Chaldean Account of Genesis, new ed. by A. H. Sayce (1880)
examined_and_rejected.reason: Rights-clean (Smith d.1876, Sayce d.1933) but rejected for quality: 1870s Izdubar/Hea-bani readings, numbered line-by-line fragments with editorial 'directions' in place of text; not readable as literature and superseded.

examined_and_rejected.title: M. Jastrow, The Religion of Babylonia and Assyria (1898), ch. XXIII
examined_and_rejected.reason: Rights-clean (Jastrow d.1921) but its translated quotations substantially duplicate Muss-Arnolt's passages with variant wording; not added, to avoid mixing readings of the same lines.
